mapper.sql: select e.id, e.paper_id, p.paper_name, e.class_id, c.class_period, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.duration_minutes, e.invigilator_user_id, coalesce(nullif(u.real_name, ''), nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) invigilator_name, e.answer_visible, e.created_at, e.updated_at from exam e inner join exam_paper p on p.id = e.paper_id inner join sys_class c on c.id = e.class_id inner join sys_user u on u.id = cast(e.invigilator_user_id as unsigned)
mapper.insert: insert into exam(paper_id, class_id, start_time, end_time, duration_minutes, invigilator_user_id, answer_visible, created_at, updated_at) values(#{paperId}, #{classId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMinutes}, #{invigilatorUserId}, 0, now(), now())
mapper.update: update exam set paper_id=#{paperId}, class_id=#{classId}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, duration_minutes=#{durationMinutes}, invigilator_user_id=#{invigilatorUserId}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update exam set answer_visible=#{answerVisible}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from exam_paper p where p.id=#{paperId} and exists(select 1 from exam_paper_question pq where pq.paper_id=p.id)
select count(1) from sys_class where id=#{classId}

select count(1) from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.id inner join sys_role r on r.id=ur.role_id where u.id=#{userId} and u.status='ACTIVE' and r.status='ACTIVE' and r.role_code='TEACHER'
select count(1) from student_exam_record where exam_id=#{examId}
